== Ingredients ==

* a little [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], [[Cookbook:Separating Eggs|separated]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Oz|oz]] finely-grated [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]

== Procedure ==

# Grease a shallow [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] with butter. Add the egg yolks.
# Mix in the salt, pepper, milk, and a little of the grated cheese.
# [[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] the egg whites to a stiff froth, and lightly [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] in the remaining cheese.
# Pile the egg white mixture on top of the egg yolks.
# Bake the whole dish in a moderate [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]].
